title: Primary street setback
text: C3.3.1 Buildings are set back from the street boundary in accordance with Table 3.3a. Table 3.3a Minimum setback of buildings from the street, primary street: R10 and R12.5 7.5m; R15-25 6m; R30-35 4m; R40 3m; R50-60 2m. Note: Where road widening is required, street setbacks are to be calculated from the adjusted street boundary following widening.

replaces.note: R30-R35 4 m, R40 3 m, R50-R60 2 m unchanged
averaging and compensation replaced by the Table 3.3b projection model (C4P1-078)

verified.note: 7.5m cell spans R10 and R12.5 (p29); Table 4A (p7) agrees.

notes: from: ch3 C3.3.1. Table 3.3a (p29) and Table 4A (p7): R10-R12.5 7.5 m, R15-R25 6 m, R30-R35 4 m, R40 3 m, R50-R60 2 m. building.primary_street_setback_m excludes minor projections (C3.3.1#r1) and portions reduced under C3.3.2. Where road widening is required the setback is measured from the adjusted street boundary (table note). A communal street has no Table 3.3a row (C3.3.1#communal-street). The table note on R80 Code Standards for single houses and grouped dwellings does not concern this chapter (C4P1-076).
